title: Vampire Vape Banana E-Liquid 10ml
description: Vampire Vapes Banana E-Liquid 10ml is a moreish treat for the tastebuds. This creamy and subtle Banana Vampire Vape e-juice is perfect for those with a real sweet tooth and who loves sweet treats. Each puff you take of this Banana Vampire Vape E Liquid offers the ultimate super smooth and creamy vape experience. Which has been enhanced further with a deliciously rich, creamy and well-balanced syrupy Banana flavour we all know and love. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
